name: awm-monorepo
description: Frontend workspace for the modular awm tree. awm/ui_components/* are importable libraries; awm/pages/* are static bundles served at /ui/<name>; awm/services/{tts,ptt} are RPC-over-WS services served at /svc/<name>. Per-package package.json + vite.config.ts are GENERATED from layout — see awm/gateway/awm/gateway/packages/gen.py.
